name: MSP_BOARD_INFO

payload_layout.note: Out/reply, VARIABLE length, in order: board_identifier (ASCII[4]); hardware_revision (u16); fc_type (u8, 0=FC / 2=FC+OSD); target_capabilities (u8 bitfield); target_name_length (u8) then target_name (ASCII[len]); board_name_length (u8) then board_name (ASCII[len]); manufacturer_id_length (u8) then manufacturer_id (ASCII[len]); signature (32 bytes). Every length prefix MUST be validated before reading; a bounded parser must never read past the frame. SIGNATURE_LENGTH=32. src/main/msp/msp.c lines 642-703 (blob 804d1dd3c9ee55cb0995f92352bac6d50911c671); BOARD_IDENTIFIER_LENGTH msp_protocol.h 80; SIGNATURE_LENGTH pg/board.h 27 @4.5.5.

verification.method: Encoded/decoded by ade-protocol-msp round-trip tests built from the same pinned records. MOCK_EXERCISED checks our codec's internal consistency only; it is not independent evidence about hardware.

licensing.note: Numeric interface constant read from a published pinned source and restated. No code, comments, tables, fixtures or error strings were copied.

notes: Board target and identifier. Required before any flashing decision.
